seo.title: Greenpill Brasil · Greenpill Network
seo.description: Greenpill Brasil bridges regenerative communities and blockchain in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, from Green Goods field pilots to the Living Center in Tijuca.

chapters.name: Greenpill Brasil
chapters.summary: Greenpill Brasil bridges regenerative communities and blockchain in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. In 2024 it piloted Green Goods at a restoration day in Rio Claro and began building the Living Center, a community hub in Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro.

chapterInitiatives.title: Water Cup
chapterInitiatives.summary: Water Cup is Greenpill Nigeria's water access project with Atlantisp2p. In June and July 2025, teams surveyed drinking water, tap access, used water disposal and sanitation in 15 communities across Anambra, Enugu and Imo States.
chapterInitiatives.description: Water Cup has three stages: mapping, implementing and maintaining. The mapping stage ran through the Greenpill dNFT campaign, and in July 2025 the chapter opened the implementation stage for funding on Impact Landscapes.

chapterInitiatives.title: Tech & Sun Round
chapterInitiatives.summary: Solar-powered container hubs with internet for student builders. The first opened at Nnamdi Azikiwe University in Awka in March 2026; a second, at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, will be completed when more funding comes in.
chapterInitiatives.description: Tech & Sun (TAS) brings reliable power, internet and Web3 education to Nigerian universities. The Awka hub hosts weekly learning days of 8 to 10 hours, and the round was matched through Localism Fund Round 1.

chapterInitiatives.title: Take the Greenpill with Greenpill Nigeria
chapterInitiatives.summary: A 10-week ReFi education program delivered online to eight communities from May to July 2025. It closed with Ethereum at 10 meetups in Awka and Enugu.
chapterInitiatives.description: Greenpill Nigeria ran the program online, four hours over two days in each community, and shared a recap on the Regen Hub in August 2025.

chapterInitiatives.title: Ethereum Localism and Public-Goods Tooling
chapterInitiatives.summary: GreenSofa public-goods tooling, Ethereum Localism education, and civic-tech bridge work in Taiwan.
chapterInitiatives.description: GreenSofa has brought funding and public goods tools such as Gitcoin, Giveth and Hypercerts into Taiwan's civic tech scene, working with g0v and local NGOs. It keeps an itemized log of its funding receipts on HackMD, runs a Hypercerts dashboard for local public goods in Taiwan, and hosted an Ethereum Localism gathering with FAB DAO on July 30, 2025.

chapterInitiatives.title: Regenerative Agriculture, Biochar, and Vermicomposting Hub
chapterInitiatives.summary: Greenpill Kenya work around environmental workshops, regenerative agriculture, tree planting, biochar, and vermicomposting.
chapterInitiatives.description: Greenpill Kenya set out its plans on the Regen Hub in 2024: environmental workshops and seminars, regenerative agriculture, tree planting, vermicomposting and biochar production, with a demo farm and tree nursery run with a partner. In its Q4 2024 update the chapter narrowed its focus to three projects, including a regen hub with a builder residency and co-working space.

chapterInitiatives.title: Environmental Monitoring and Cleanup
chapterInitiatives.summary: Weekly cleanups and community air quality monitoring on Koh Phangan, where the Decentralized Cleanup initiative began.
chapterInitiatives.description: GreenPill Phangan cleans beaches and promotes the Monthly Earth Day movement on the island. The Decentralized Cleanup initiative began in the chapter in 2024, and in 2025 the chapter began placing Altruist air quality sensors at about five locations. During Artizen Season 6 in 2026 it joined weekly Clean Phangan cleanups and boat trips to Koh Tae Nae.

chapterInitiatives.title: Ethereum 10Y Cape Town
chapterInitiatives.summary: Ethereum's tenth anniversary celebration at Rooftop on Bree on July 30, 2025. Greenpill Cape Town was an event partner and planned to show the global livestream at the venue.
chapterInitiatives.description: ETHGlobal, Silhouette and Envio hosted the celebration, with Greenpill listed among the partners.

chapterInitiatives.title: 10 Years of Ethereum Phangan
chapterInitiatives.summary: A celebration of Ethereum's tenth anniversary on July 30, 2025, hosted by GreenPill Phangan and ReFi Phangan at MESTO on Koh Phangan.
chapterInitiatives.description: An evening program on Koh Phangan that included the Ethereum Foundation's anniversary livestream.

chapterInitiatives.title: Web3 Solutions for Local Impact
chapterInitiatives.summary: A fireside chat on May 15, 2025, during Consensus in Toronto, on Web3, regeneration, public goods funding and local impact.
chapterInitiatives.description: GreenPill TO's fireside chat brought together investors, builders, academics, nonprofits and Indigenous leaders to discuss ReFi, Ethereum Localism, public goods funding and community projects. It was held at Lodge On Queen.

chapterInitiatives.title: Reimagining Our Future Meetups
chapterInitiatives.summary: A monthly GreenPill Ottawa meetup in 2023 about regenerative finance, web3 coordination and positive local and global impact.
chapterInitiatives.description: The last listed meetup, Reimagining Our Future, took place on July 17, 2023, at 70 Beech St in Ottawa.

chapterInitiatives.title: Greenpill NYC Meetups
chapterInitiatives.summary: Regular meetups in New York City for people who care about public goods, listed on the Greenpill NYC Luma calendar.
chapterInitiatives.description: In 2024 the chapter described its focus as educating New Yorkers about the value of onchain public goods mechanisms through monthly meetups. Recent meetups took place on April 22 and June 30, 2026.

chapterInitiatives.title: Agroforestry Task Force and Living Center
chapterInitiatives.summary: Greenpill Brasil's agroforestry task force in Rio de Janeiro and the Living Center, a community hub for education, agroecology and culture in Tijuca.
chapterInitiatives.description: In 2024 the agroforestry task force held an event on food sovereignty and biodiversity, and the chapter ran the AgroforestDAO Journey, a training program that introduced agroforesters to quadratic funding, POAPs and decentralized governance. The first phase of the Living Center, foundations and roofing, was completed on November 30, 2024.

chapterInitiatives.title: La Ligne Verte
chapterInitiatives.summary: A Telegram chatbot, with WhatsApp planned, where residents report trash-filled areas and earn points, with bonus points for cleaning them up. Every report feeds an open data map.
chapterInitiatives.description: Greenpill Côte d'Ivoire presented La Ligne Verte as its Green Mission 2025 in Gitcoin Grants. A beta version runs on Telegram, and the project won a UNDP Côte d'Ivoire hackathon on AI and biodiversity protection, which partly funds it. Next steps include storing data in a smart contract and launching the first field actions.

chapterInitiatives.title: Publications and Learning Series
chapterInitiatives.summary: Uncommons translations, reading groups and talks on crypto humanities, value and the commons.
chapterInitiatives.description: Uncommons published a Chinese edition of MycoFi on the Greenpill Network website in 2024 and runs UnResearch, a project on crypto humanities. In December 2025 and January 2026 its X account announced a Tokens reading group session and talks with Vasilis Kostakis of the P2P Lab and with Alex Pazaitis.

chapterInitiatives.title: ReFi, DeSci, and Community Activation
chapterInitiatives.summary: ReFi meetups in Hamburg (July 2023) and Munich (August 2023), a first hypercert launch in October 2023, and DeSci work at Berlin Science Week.
chapterInitiatives.description: In an August 2024 update on the Regen Hub, the chapter listed community activation and steward onboarding as current work and education campaigns as next.

chapterInitiatives.title: Vibe Coding for Good
chapterInitiatives.summary: Collaborative build night at Reimagine Co presented by Greenpill London Ontario on April 28, 2026.
chapterInitiatives.description: An evening build night at Reimagine Co, 206 Piccadilly St, London, Ontario, organized by Greenpill London Ontario with Heenal Rajani.

projects.summary: Offline-first impact verification for regenerative work.
projects.description: Green Goods is a mobile-first PWA built by the Greenpill Dev Guild to document and verify ecological and social work. Public sources describe an offline-first flow where operators approve submissions and impact can be anchored with Ethereum Attestation Service on Arbitrum, with Green Goods positioned as core infrastructure for public proof.
